verdict.rationale: Aircall markets built-in AI Assistants that give real-time guidance and automatically capture notes, update CRM records and create follow-up tasks. It also markets AI Agents that handle calls and multi-step actions such as Shopify lookups, Stripe refunds, calendar booking and CRM logging. These are first-party capabilities, but the evidence shows automatic call-scoped actions, not a user giving the assistant arbitrary tasks, and it rests only on marketing copy. Missing for 10: evidence that users can directly instruct or delegate ad-hoc tasks to the assistant, in-depth product documentation of the assistant's scope and controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
